title: Sources: SpaceX weighs filing confidentially for an IPO as soon as March, targeting a June listing that could raise up to $50B at a $1.75T valuation (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: SpaceX weighs filing confidentially for an IPO as soon as March, targeting a June listing that could raise up to $50B at a $1.75T valuation — SpaceX is targeting filing confidentially for an initial public offering as soon as next month, according to people familiar with the matter …
